description: Norway Annual Accounts - Brønnøysund Financial Statements. Get the filed annual accounts (årsregnskap) of Norwegian companies by organisation number (organisasjonsnummer, 9 digits) from the Brønnøysund Register of Company Accounts: revenue, operating profit, net profit, total assets, equity and liabilities, checked against the balance sheet. One row per company, fiscal year and statement type (up to 3 years; consolidated group accounts optional, each an extra row and charge). Use it after a free Brreg (Enhetsregisteret) lookup when you need the numbers, not just the identity. If the run is not finished in time, the tool returns {status, runId, note} - call regdata_run_result with that runId instead of re-running (re-running bills twice). No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companyIds.description: Norwegian organisation numbers (organisasjonsnummer), 9 digits, up to 1,000 per run. Example: 923609016.
companyIds.title: Organisation numbers

includeConsolidated.description: Also return the consolidated group accounts when the company files them. Each group statement is an extra row and an extra charge. Off by default.
includeConsolidated.title: Include group (consolidated) accounts

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

years.description: How many of the most recent fiscal years to return for each company (1 to 3). Each year is one row and one charge.
years.title: Fiscal years per company

name: regdata_norway_annual_accounts
